# Google Scholar

> > Google Scholar is a freely accessible search engine for scholarly literature, indexing academic papers, citations, and researcher profiles across all disciplines.

Google Scholar provides comprehensive coverage of peer-reviewed papers, theses, books, and conference proceedings from academic publishers and universities worldwide. The platform includes features for citation tracking, author profiles, journal metrics (h-index), and advanced search operators for academic research.

## Key Topics

- Academic search
- Citation management
- Citation tracking
- Scholarly articles
- Research database
- Scholar Profiles
- Citation metrics
- h-index
- Advanced search operators
- Academic library integration
- Document ranking
- Researcher profiles
- Publication metrics
- Peer-reviewed literature
- Interdisciplinary research

## Core Features

- [Google Scholar Homepage](https://scholar.google.com/?hl=tr): Main search interface for finding scholarly literature across all academic disciplines
- [About Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/intl//scholar/about.html): Overview of Google Scholar's mission, search capabilities, and academic ranking methodology
- [Google Scholar Profiles](https://scholar.google.com/intl/en/scholar/citations.html): Author profile pages for tracking publications, citations, h-index, and collaboration networks

## Help & Documentation

- [Search Help](https://scholar.google.com/intl//scholar/help.html): Comprehensive guide to search operators, library links, and advanced search techniques
- [Google Scholar Metrics Help](https://scholar.google.com/intl/zh-CN/scholar/metrics.html): Documentation for understanding citation metrics, h-index calculations, and publication rankings
